_comment: Art the game loads by path the first time something appears, preloaded in the background at map start so that moment doesn't stall a frame (UWRPreloadSubsystem, Docs/PERFORMANCE.md). Every /Game/ path in the 'scan' files is preloaded (creatures' meshes, clips and materials, player bodies and held weapons), plus 'assets' (the caves, loaded when one comes within 250 m).
